controls.label: Monochrome
controls.notes: USGS Voyager/Galileo mosaic at a 1 km map grid. Original observations vary from about 400 m to 20 km per pixel. Gray grid marks documented missing imagery. Photographed terrain shading remains; added globe lighting is approximate.

controls.label: False color
controls.notes: USGS color mosaic combines near-infrared, green and violet observations with sharper monochrome detail. The source is photometrically normalized and brightness matched. Monochrome remains at the poles, in missing color coverage, and across the source's 210–250° west sector whose red channel was synthesized. This is false color, not natural color; source resolution and seams vary.

controls.label: Geology

legend.title: Geologic units
legend.meta: Symbols identify archived categories. Colors are chosen for this display.

controls.notes: Twenty-three archived map symbols distinguish interpreted dark and light terrains, crater and basin materials. Colors are categorical display choices. The GIS combines palimpsest age classes under p; the view preserves that combined symbol. Gray grid marks areas without an unambiguous polygon. No measured relief is added.

controls.label: Oxygen signature
controls.notes: Published reflectance ratio sensitive to the 577.3 nm molecular-oxygen feature in surface ice. This is neither oxygen concentration nor atmospheric density. Spectral slope, the adjacent instrument gap and residual night-to-night differences affect contrasts. Values below one are retained. Two-degree samples and seams remain visible; gray grid marks missing or withheld edges. Absolute subpixel registration is unresolved.
